# Trick or Treat (TREAT) — machine-readable project facts

Name: Trick or Treat
Symbol: TREAT
Network: BNB Chain (BSC, chainId 56)
Contract: 0xe98b80088449C545162BE71e78fF0298382b7ff5
Site: https://trickortreat-bsc.github.io/trickortreat/
Permit gate: https://permit-worker.reuniakbarpunk212.workers.dev/treat
Agent instructions: https://trickortreat-bsc.github.io/trickortreat/skill.md

## What it is
A Halloween share sale of the TREAT ERC-20 token. 5,000 shares exist; one
share is 1,000,000 TREAT. The whole supply (5,000,000,000 TREAT) sits in the
contract and is distributed only through the two paths below. The contract
has no owner, no admin functions, and no way to mint more.

## Free share (one per wallet, one per X account)
1. The claimer posts a prepared message on X. The message contains the site
   link above and the claimer's wallet code (the last 6 hex characters of
   the claiming wallet address, lowercase).
2. The claimer submits { wallet, postUrl } to the permit gate. The gate
   fetches the post, checks the author matches the URL and both markers are
   present, then returns an EIP-712 permit: { handleHash, deadline,
   signature } (valid 2 hours).
3. The claimer calls claimFree(handleHash, deadline, signature) on the
   contract and receives 1,000,000 TREAT.
The contract itself enforces one claim per wallet and one claim per X
handle (handleHash = keccak256 of the lowercase handle). Calls without a
valid permit are rejected.

## Paid shares (no post needed)
Call buy(n), 1 to 20 shares per call, paying the exact amount returned by
quote(n). The price starts at 0.0005 BNB per share and rises by 0.0001 BNB
after every 250 shares distributed (free claims count toward the ladder),
up to a top price of 0.0024 BNB for the final 250 shares. 100% of each
payment is forwarded to the project treasury in the same transaction.

## End of sale
There is no time limit. The sale ends when all 5,000 shares are distributed.

## Useful contract reads
totalOut() — shares distributed so far (free + paid)
priceNow() — current price per share in wei
quote(n) — total cost in wei of buying n shares now
freeClaimed(address) — whether a wallet already took its free share
sharesOf(address) — whole shares held by a wallet
balanceOf(address) — TREAT balance (18 decimals)
